name: Reiterhof Camping
beschreibung: The Reiterhof Camping is located in Hopfgarten im Brixental in Tirol and lies at an altitude of around 620 meters, surrounded by the mountains of the Brixental. The campsite offers pitches for motorhomes and tents as well as sanitary facilities with showers and toilets. The atmosphere is quiet and rural, as the site adjoins a riding stable and is surrounded by meadows and alpine pastures. Nearby is the Skigebiet Hohe Salve, which offers skiing and snowboarding in winter. In summer, numerous hiking and cycling trails are available in the Brixental, which can be reached directly from the site. The region also offers opportunities for mountain biking, climbing, and swimming in nearby outdoor pools or lakes. Guests will find basic facilities on the site, such as electricity connections and a fresh water supply. The connection to the public transport network and the proximity to the town center of Hopfgarten make shopping and excursions easy.
